turns.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: the reward is $35 off. To unlock your code, you need to say at least 1,200 words on this call: the "Your words" bar at the bottom of your screen counts them. You can stop whenever you like, but it only unlocks once you reach that. I see you were looking at the Large Laminated World Wall Map. It's sold out right now. What were you hoping it would do for you?
I'm looking for a laminated map of the world for my grandson who is nine.
The size that you're offering here is too large. Do you have a smaller one that I could be interested in?
I'm sorry, the only world maps I know of are that same large size, and they're all sold out. Would a small globe for a nine-year-old interest you instead?
No. I'm particularly interested in a wall map.
A wall map makes sense, it stays up and he can look any time. What would make a map feel right for him, the size, the look, or something else?
Both the size and the look, but they are in a small place. So I think the one that you're offering is too big. I just thought you might have a smaller one.
I hear you, and I'm sorry, we don't have a smaller map right now. What would you want to see in a kid's map that you didn't find here?
No problem. How did you find Replogle Globes in the first place?
